notes.title: Your feedback, built in
items: Make your own week: in Plan & workouts, pick a workout for every day (one of yours or one from your plan) and it repeats every week. No more changing it day by day.
Send a workout to a friend: tap the share button next to one of your workouts and send the link in WhatsApp, Messages or any chat. Your friend taps it and saves a copy, on iPhone or Android.
Logging a set: Paused, Partial, Failed and Drop set now sit under every set of every exercise. Nothing is ticked for you anymore, so a set only counts as paused if you say so.
Sets without weight: step the weight down to 0, or type 0, for bodyweight sets like pull-ups without a belt. Drop sets can go down to 0 kg too.
Every exercise can now be done one side at a time. Tap “One side” and pick left or right.
Swapping an exercise: every option now shows the muscle it works and a match meter, best matches first. One tap swaps it in.
Rest timer: tap the time to type your own rest, like 2:30 or 90. The exercise keeps that rest for the rest of the workout. There's a −30 button now too.
Android: when you leave the app during a rest, your notifications show when the rest ends, and you get a buzz when it's over. Allow notifications when the app asks.
This page: every update, in plain words. A green dot on Settings means there's something new.

notes.title: Setline in your browser
items: Setline now runs in any browser, Android included, with the same account as the iPhone app.
Sign-in and password-reset links bring you straight back into the app.
Leaving a workout you picked up again keeps it, instead of throwing it away.
Your own workouts: one row per exercise, and Save or Cancel when you build one.
Workout places show on a real map, and you can name the friends you trained with.
